newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 5.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Lower House expected to pass fiscal 1997/98 budget.
-- Identities of five Japanese Red Army detainees in Lebanon confirmed.
-- Leading manufacturers plan to curb wage hikes, place focus on bonuses in spring wage talks.
-- More than 40 percent of leading companies to speed up recruitment of college graduates.
-- Government proposes revising law to get power to ban overseas remittances without a resolution by United Nations against a target country.
